meta.name: Africa Screams
meta.description:
from IMDB.com:
"Abbott & Costello search for diamonds in Africa, along the way meeting a visually-impaired gunner, a hungry lion, and a tribe of cannibals."

Also stars Clyde Beatty and Shemp Howard.

You can load the mpeg2 file into DVDAuthorGUI (a free program) and create a DVD to watch on your television.
